questions.question: "Christian aid organisations should only help Christians." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Some might argue that Christian charities should prioritise fellow Christians, especially those persecuted for their faith. However, the Parable of the Good Samaritan teaches that Christians should help anyone in need, regardless of their religion. Jesus helped people from other faiths (the Samaritan woman, the Roman centurion). CAFOD, Christian Aid and Tearfund help people of all faiths and none,
